boundary_note: Glatz 24 June: the entrenched camp is the combat objective; conditional fortress agreement is separate. Tactical and campaign replacement boundaries are unset; phases are research hypotheses. No feature admission or historical rating fit.

claims.value: Bodart: side A about 5,000 assault troops under Deroy; broader blockade 13,000 under Vandamme; side B 2,800 in the entrenched camp under Götzen.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "The Bavarians, Württembergers and Saxons, together about 5,000 under Bavarian Lieutenant-General von Deroy, take by storm the ten redoubts of the Glatz camp defended by 2,800 Prussians under Lieutenant-Colonel Count von Götzen." English rendering of the added paragraph (ours): After the camp fell, Götzen agreed with Vandamme, who blockaded the fortress with 13,000 men, to surrender it on 26 July 1807 if not relieved. Tilsit prevented the fortress from passing into enemy hands.

citations.quote: Die Bayern, Württemberger und Sachsen (zus. ca. 5.000 M.) unter dem bayrischen Gen.-Lt. v. Deroy erobern die von 2.800 Preußen unter Obstlt. Gf. v. Götzen verteidigten 10 Schanzen des Glatzer Lagers mit Sturm.

Infolge der Einnahme des verschanzten Lagers schloß Obstlt. Gf. v. Götzen mit dem französischen Div.-Gen. Vandamme, welcher an der Spitze von 13.000 M. die Festung blokierte, die Kapitulation, wonach Glatz am 26. Juli 1807, falls bis dahin kein Entsatz stattfände, den Franzosen übergeben werden und die Besatzung in Kriegsgefangenschaft geraten solle. Auf Grund des mittlerweile zustande gekommenen Tilsiter Friedens gelangte Glatz nicht in Feindeshand.

claims.value: Höpfner assigns 2,136 infantry/artillery and 588 horses to the entrenched camp, including reserves and more than 200 infantry detached to pickets.
claims.rationale: Horses are not silently converted into cavalry people; camp differs from fortress and wider mobile force. English rendering (ours): "Altogether assigned to the defence of the entrenched camp were 2,136 infantry and artillery men and 588 horses" English rendering (ours): "altogether more than 200 infantry men"

citations.quote: Im Ganzen waren somit für die Vertheidigung des verschanzten Lagers bestimmt: 2136 Mann Infanterie und Artillerie, 588 Pferde

claims.value: Höpfner puts the allied force available for operations against Glatz above 13,000 after 4–5,000 joined under Vandamme from Neisse.
claims.rationale: Available operation force, not assault strength; enemy-side estimate from Prussian history. English rendering (ours): "so that the total force ready for operations against Glatz exceeded 13,000 men." English rendering (ours): "From 16 June, after Neisse’s surrender, these troops were reinforced by another 4–5,000 under Vandamme"

citations.quote: so daß die Gesammtmacht, welche zur Operation nach Glatz bereit war, über 13,000 M. betrug.
Vom 16. Juni ab wurden diese Truppen nach der Uebergabe von Neiße noch durch 4—5000 Mann unter dem General Vandamme verstärkt

claims.value: Jérôme’s disposition assigned Vandamme the left bank and Deroy the right bank, with bridges linking the wings.
claims.rationale: The preceding order assigns Vandamme the left-bank investment; superior, bank and assault roles differ. English rendering (ours): "while General Deroy operated with the Bavarians on the right bank of the Neisse"

citations.quote: während der General Deroy mit den Bayern auf dem rechten Neiße-Ufer operirte

claims.value: Götzen exercised wider direction; Gleissenberg commanded Glatz, Braun the Schäferberg and Albu was mining colonel.
claims.rationale: Götzen directed these officers to report on defence means; rank/listing alone does not allocate battle credit. English rendering (ours): "the commandant of Glatz, Colonel Gleissenberg, mining colonel Albu and the commandant of the Schäferberg, Lieutenant-Colonel Braun"

citations.quote: dem Kommandanten von Glatz, Obersten Gleissenberg, dem Mineur-Obersten Albu und dem Kommandanten des Schäferberges, Oberst-Lieutenant Braun

claims.value: The camp had individually garrisoned redoubts and a reserve redoubt; the fortress was a distinct position.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "In reserve redoubt No. 10, Lieutenant Reichmeister with 249 men"

claims.value: Allied battalions attacked the reserve redoubt, Bavarians on the right, Württembergers and Saxons on the left.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "At the same time reserve redoubt No. 10 was attacked by several enemy battalions, Bavarians on the right and Württembergers and Saxons on the left."

citations.quote: Zu derselben Zeit wurde die Reserve-Schanze Nr. 10. durch mehrere feindliche Bataillone, rechts durch die Bayern, links durch die Württemberger und Sachsen angegriffen.

claims.value: Götzen received a royal order dated 14 June saying no help could be expected from Prussia; the order’s receipt and the later assault are different events.
claims.rationale: Mediated royal instruction; no exact receipt timestamp assigned. English rendering (ours): "that in the present state of affairs in Prussia no help from there for Silesia could be contemplated"
